texts.zh:
由于轨道上存在着许多太空垃圾和小型轨道碎片，我们在[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的环境改造工程师正在面临着危险的工作环境。其极大的数量给穿梭机在地表和轨道间往回航行带来了危险。

由于这些物体的密度极高，我们起早了一份，将其中最大的一些碎片进行磁化，使其在轨道上吸引其他的碎片，最后逐渐整合成一个更便于管理的整体。我们任务应该能制造出一颗人工卫星。

虽然这将增加环境改造的时间，但它将大大方便穿梭车进入地表，并消除大型轨道碎片频繁进入行星大气的风险。
texts.en:
Our terraforming engineers on [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] are facing hazardous working conditions due to various pieces of space junk and minor debris orbiting the planet. The high volume of these objects pose a navigational danger for shuttles traveling to and from the surface.

Given the sheer density of the material, we have drawn up proposals to magnetize the largest of these fragments so that they attract others as they orbit, gradually consolidating everything into a single and more manageable entity. We theorize it will be possible to effectively create an artificial moon.

While this would increase terraforming time, it would greatly ease shuttle access to the surface and remove the risk of larger orbital debris periodically entering the planet's atmosphere.

label.zh: 环境改造完成：生成垃圾之月
label.en: Terraforming completes: the junk moon spawns
It will burn up on its own.

texts.zh:
将环绕[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的太空垃圾进行整合的工作成功了。

通过将许多大型碎片磁化后，我们逐渐将所有的物体集合成一个巨大的废金属团块。它的密度上升至足以产生自身引力的可观水平。这颗新形成的卫星随后被送入了稳定的轨道。

摆脱了这些危险的轨道碎片之后，前往[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的表面容易多了，我们再也不用担心这些东西掉入大气层。不仅如此，我们的工程师也确信这颗新的卫星甚至可以承载自己的开采站。
texts.en:
Efforts to consolidate the space junk orbiting [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] were successful.

By magnetizing many of the larger pieces, we gradually gathered everything into a massive single body of scrap metal. Its density has risen to the point where it now has its own appreciable level of gravitational attraction. This newly-created moon has since settled into a stable orbit.

Access to [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]'s surface is much easier without the hazardous orbital debris, and we no longer have to worry about its potential entry into the atmosphere. Moreover, our engineers are confident that this new moon can support its own mining station.

tooltips.en: [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] has a new moon: Junk Moon

summary.text:
# 轨道残骸 / Orbital Debris

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/strange_worlds_terraforming_events.txt:573-723; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2105,2125 on_terraforming_progress_25 / on_terraforming_complete · DLC: BioGenesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

星球环境改造进行到25%时（on_terraforming_progress_25，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2105，随机30/180），若星系里有被毁巨型建筑、该星球首次改造且国家尚未触发过，隐藏事件 strange_worlds.1045 记下该星球，30+150天后 strange_worlds.1050。

When a planet's terraforming reaches 25% (on_terraforming_progress_25, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2105, random 30/180), if the system has a ruined megastructure, it is the planet's first terraformation and the country has not had the chain, hidden strange_worlds.1045 records the planet and strange_worlds.1050 follows after 30+150 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

strange_worlds.1050“轨道残骸”：a“给我们造一个卫星”——改造总时间+25%，并在改造完成时（on_terraforming_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2125）由隐藏事件 strange_worlds.1055 触发 strange_worlds.1060“垃圾之月”（生成一颗含矿物与合金矿点的垃圾卫星）；b“它自己会烧掉的”——星球获得 d_space_junk_hazards 矿点。两者都给工程研究。

strange_worlds.1050 "Orbital Debris": a "Make us a moon" - terraforming takes 25% longer and, when it completes (on_terraforming_complete, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2125), hidden strange_worlds.1055 fires strange_worlds.1060 "Junk Moon" (a junk moon with mineral and alloy deposits is spawned); b "It will burn up on its own" - the planet gets the d_space_junk_hazards deposit. Both give engineering research.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

a（垃圾之月）与 b（碎片危害）互斥。

a (junk moon) and b (debris hazards) are exclusive.
